Rashi on Chullin 27b:18:5.hebrew: מי סברת בעוף - קאי? בחיה קאי, דכסוי דידה כי כתיב אהכשרה כתיב, והכשרה דידה שחיטה היא:
Rashi on Chullin 27b:18:5.english: Did you think it is regarding a bird - that it refers [to it]? It refers to a wild animal! For the covering of it, when it is written, is written with regard to its fitness [for eating], and its fitness is slaughter.

Rashi on Chullin 27b:19:1.english: One who slaughters - [A species] that requires covering [of the blood].

Rashi on Chullin 27b:19:2.english: And he needs the blood - As [the baraita] explains.

Rashi on Chullin 27b:19:3.hebrew: חייב לכסות - על כרחו, ושוב לא יראה למלאכה:
Rashi on Chullin 27b:19:3.english: He is obligated to cover - Against his will, and then [the blood] will no longer be fit for use in the work.

Rashi on Chullin 27b:19:4.hebrew: כיצד עושה - להפטר מן הכסוי, נוחרו או עוקרו:
Rashi on Chullin 27b:19:4.english: How does he do it? - [How does he act] in order to be exempt from covering [the blood]? [He may] stab it or tear out [its windpipe or gullet].
